Entry5970..6125 constructs external input/kernel pointers and integer locals; leading stage exits6167..6183,6218..6231 and6278..6290 initialize the next output row without vector stack traffic. .L408 at6349 initializes e and sets t=4; .L418 at6371 enters shared. At shared entry/exit the25 acc remain in registers; n0 temporarily relocates b0 fromz14 toz12, restores it, then n1 similarly relocates b1 fromz13 toz12 and restores it. The trailing stages6490..6673 read their final kernel rows in order with no spill/reload between phases. .L419 at6674 emits25 full-vector output stores before horizontal pointers advance. .L429 at6843 supplies zero-valued accumulators when kw<=0 and rejoins .L408; it does not materialize stack-resident vectors. helpers.tail_and_fallback_review: Entry CMP w3,4 / BLE .L405 implements kh<5 before leading-row pointer construction or arithmetic. .L4056947..6979 calls rowquad for outputs0..3 with original width, then tail-branches prefix for output4 at base+4*stride. Full horizontal tiles are gated by CNTW mul#5 and ow-i>=5*lanes; INCW mul#5 at6725 advances exactly that tile width. .L4496980..6994 initializes i=0 for ow<5*lanes, then .L407 compares ow with i. .L4506886..6946 handles any remaining0<ow-i<5*lanes by rowquad at column i for the first four rows and prefix at input row4, column i for the fifth row; dst pointers retain their external row spacing. Every phase is a single-column loop starting ik=0 and incrementing by1, with CMP/BGT against kw; odd/even kw and kw=1 use the same loop, with no paired/quartet remainder or wide coefficient read. The final loaded horizontal vector starts at i+4*lanes+ik and ends at i+5*lanes+ik-1; the full-tile condition and ik<kw bound it by ow+kw-2. The last input row is kh+3, needed by output row4. Per-output kernel rows and columns remain increasing, with separate FMUL then FADD.
